purpose: Define the loop-external evidence required before a development residual reader may be considered for owner publication or any runtime experiment.
required_bindings: exact base-model revision and file digests
exact reader artifact and task-project lineage
sealed source-separated fit and qualification corpora
frozen prompt, labels, views, seeds, metrics, thresholds, and kill conditions
independent formal validator implementation and digest
required_checks: cross-view language, format, order, role, and counterfactual validity
causal target effect and dose response
